# SQLCipher WAL fixtures

Generated by SQLCipher 4.20.0 community / SQLite 3.54.1, using compatibility
3, compatibility 4, and custom 2048-byte pages with 100,000 SHA-256 KDF
iterations and SHA-256 page HMAC. The public test passphrase is `wal-fixture`.

`main.db` pairs with either `history.wal` or `shrink.wal`. `expected.db` and
`shrunk.db` are the respective reference images checkpointed by SQLCipher.
Synthetic data for unpublished integration tests.

Regenerate with `python3 generate.py /path/to/sqlcipher`. It validates all three
profiles and copies only while its writer is idle; it is not a live backup tool.
